transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling Tech Solutions! This is Emily. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Emily, I’m having trouble accessing my account. I keep getting a password error.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that. Let’s get this sorted out. Can you please confirm the email address associated with your account?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.smith@email.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, John. I’ll send you a password reset link right now. It should arrive shortly in your inbox. 

**Customer:** I appreciate that, but I also wanted to ask about the billing cycle. I think I was charged twice this month.

**Agent:** I can help with that too. Let me pull up your billing details. Can you hold on for a moment, please?

**Customer:** Yes, of course.

**Agent:** Thanks for your patience, John. I see you were billed for both the Pro plan and an add-on feature. Did you intend to have both?

**Customer:** No, I only wanted the Pro plan. I didn’t realize the add-on would come with it!

**Agent:** I understand how that can be confusing. I can go ahead and refund the charge for the add-on if you confirm you don’t need it.

**Customer:** Yes, please do that. I’d like to keep things simple for now.

**Agent:** Absolutely, I’ll process that refund right away. You should see it in your account within 3-5 business days.

**Customer:** Thank you! Also, when will I receive the password reset link?

**Agent:** It should arrive shortly, but if you don’t see it in your inbox, please check your spam folder as well.

**Customer:** Got it. I really appreciate your help today, Emily!

**Agent:** You’re welcome, John! If you have any more questions, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
